title: Yellow Malted Irish Lamb Stew
description: A hearty and comforting Irish lamb stew with a malty flavor and fluffy texture, perfect for a rainy day. The dish features a poached lamb shoulder and a dash of vinegar for added depth.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the lamb shoulder and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the malted milk powder, apple cider vinegar, chicken broth, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes, and stir to combine.
Cover the Dutch oven and transfer to the preheated oven.
Braise the stew for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the vegetables are cooked through.
Remove the stew from the oven and stir in the chopped parsley.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
